# StarVLA compatibility runtime

This directory preserves the `starVLA` and `deployment` Python namespaces used
by the released RoboTwin training configuration and checkpoint loader. Public
TurboVLA commands live under `experiments/robotwin/` and `scripts/robotwin/`;
this compatibility layer is not a separate subproject. See
`third_party/licenses/StarVLA-MIT.txt` and the retained source-file notices.
